answer_text:
Looking at this problem, I need to determine the discriminant $d(K)$ of $K = \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{2}, \sqrt{3})$.

## Setting Up the Discriminant

The discriminant of a number field equals the discriminant of any integral basis. The problem states that $S$ is an integral basis and $D(S) = 147456$.

## Verification Using the Standard Integral Basis

I can verify this independently using the standard integral basis $\{1, \sqrt{2}, \sqrt{3}, \sqrt{6}\}$ (valid since $2 \not\equiv 1 \pmod{4}$ and $3 \not\equiv 1 \pmod{4}$).

The embedding matrix is:
$$M_0 = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 & 1 \\ \sqrt{2} & \sqrt{2} & -\sqrt{2} & -\sqrt{2} \\ \sqrt{3} & -\sqrt{3} & \sqrt{3} & -\sqrt{3} \\ \sqrt{6} & -\sqrt{6} & -\sqrt{6} & \sqrt{6} \end{pmatrix}$$

**Column operations** (with $\det(T)=1$): replacing columns with $C_1+C_4,\; C_2+C_3,\; C_1-C_4,\; C_2-C_3$ gives:
$$M_0' = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2\sqrt{2} & 2\sqrt{2} \\ 0 & 0 & 2\sqrt{3} & -2\sqrt{3} \\ 2\sqrt{6} & -2\sqrt{6} & 0 & 0 \end{pmatrix}$$

After reordering rows (even number of swaps), this becomes block-diagonal:
$$A = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 2 \\ 2\sqrt{6} & -2\sqrt{6} \end{pmatrix}, \qquad B = \begin{pmatrix} 2\sqrt{2} & 2\sqrt{2} \\ 2\sqrt{3} & -2\sqrt{3} \end{pmatrix}$$

**Computing the determinants:**
$$\det(A) = -4\sqrt{6} - 4\sqrt{6} = -8\sqrt{6}$$
$$\det(B) = -4\sqrt{6} - 4\sqrt{6} = -8\sqrt{6}$$

**Final result:**
$$\det(M_0) = (-8\sqrt{6})(-8\sqrt{6}) = 64 \cdot 6 = 384$$

$$d(K) = 384^2 = 147456$$

## Confirming the Factorization

$$147456 = 2^{14} \cdot 3^2$$

This is consistent with the quadratic subfield discriminants:
- $d(\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{2})) = 8 = 2^3$
- $d(\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{3})) = 12 = 2^2 \cdot 3$  
- $d(\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{6})) = 24 = 2^3 \cdot 3$

The product $8 \times 12 \times 24 = 2^8 \cdot 3^2 = 2304$, and $147456 = 64 \times 2304 = 2^6 \cdot 2^8 \cdot 3^2 = 2^{14} \cdot 3^2$. ✓

## Conclusion

Since $S$ is an integral basis, the discriminant of the field equals the discriminant of the basis:

$$d(K) = D(S) = 147456$$

$$\boxed{147456}$$
